runtime_boundary.corpus_scope: the same ten original context paragraphs for each question
runtime_boundary.document_unit: one distinct Wikipedia article title, not a sentence or chunk
runtime_boundary.shuffle_context: stable hash order independent of supporting facts

comparison_arms.definition: Normalized dense similarity; relevance-only selection and packing.
BM25 and dense reciprocal-rank fusion; relevance-only selection and packing.
Development-selected multi-document selection and metadata-preserving context assembly.
Remove only the proposed cross-document selection component; hold other settings fixed.

shared_constraints.context_budget_includes: evidence text and its document/location headings

metrics.primary_definition: Fraction of questions for which the packed context retains evidence from both annotated supporting documents.

scorer.answer_prediction: short_answer, not the entire explanatory prose
scorer.support_prediction: union of the title/sentence pairs cited by the answer claims

analysis.denominator: all selected questions, including provider and validation failures
analysis.claim_rule: Report paired gains against both standard baselines, support-fact and answer tradeoffs, and uncertainty; a non-positive gain is an unmet requirement, not grounds to replace losing questions.
analysis.manual_claim_review: Same preselected question IDs across all arms, blinded arm names, recorded support/completeness rubric; no paid judge by default.

limits: This is a filtered 60-question subset of the public development set, not the official hidden test set or leaderboard.
Each question is bounded to ten original paragraphs; full-Wikipedia retrieval and growing-corpus scalability are not established.
Necessity review is source-based eligibility screening, not evidence that a pretrained model cannot guess or memorize an answer.
Held-out questions are held out from pipeline tuning, not unseen to the eligibility reviewer.
Article titles and sentence annotations are used for evaluation; valid locations alone do not establish semantic citation support.
Short reference answers and imperfect annotations can undercount correct paraphrases; retain raw predictions and honest error analysis.
Algorithm-specific settings and the proposed selector remain to be selected on development data and frozen in T11.
